scope: Read-only provenance and implementation audit; no new experiments, tests, server access, or repository changes in this audit turn. Existing local source, saved server audit and official paper/repository sources inspected.

classification_definitions.official_direct: Official implementation called at runtime, with execution evidence.
classification_definitions.official_vendored_pinned: Official source copied with verifiable upstream commit and executed-file identity.
classification_definitions.local_reimplementation: Locally written implementation of source formulas.
classification_definitions.adaptation: Substantive changes to algorithm, schedule, parameters, normalization or task protocol.
classification_definitions.concept_control: Local control inspired by a prior idea; not a reproduction of the published method.

overall: Within this assigned group, no official-direct or commit-proven official-vendored execution was established. LT and DeCE are local reimplementations with adaptations; GradSentry is a local formula implementation plus adaptation, evaluated only as an offline census; stop/lowlr/rank/fulltoken are local controls. No original-task positive reproduction was found in inspected evidence.
official_source_revision_limit: Official URLs inspected are current public main/master snapshots; historical upstream commits used during original implementation remain unverified. official_sources.detail: Kang and Hashimoto ACL 2020; primary task Gigaword abstractive headline generation, plus E2E.
Section 4.1: online quantile over last 10000 examples, update every 10000. Section 5.1 Gigaword c=0.6; Appendix C hotstart 100000 minibatch updates plus 100000 truncation updates.
Class defaults dropc=0.4, min_count=10000, recompute=10000; current loss enters ring before quantile recomputation and masking; returns a mask, not a reduced loss.

substantive_differences: Ring buffer/recompute reduced from 10000 to160 consumed rows.
Activation uses current-task median-loss gate or fixed H steps (20/50/100/150), not original task hotstart protocol.
c sweep {0.01,0.05,0.1,0.4}; chose0.05 on B seed1106. Official dropper code default0.4 and paper Gigaword0.6 are different reference levels.

Local thresholds are computed from prior cache then current batch is filtered, then current losses enter buffer. Official class first inserts current loss and then may recompute. Local recompute >=160 versus official >recompute.

Local scores are per-row mean answer-token CE; shared trainer renormalizes updates by kept valid tokens per microbatch. Dropper class itself does not specify downstream reduction; official caller still needed to establish exact original update normalization.

official_sources.detail: Section4 defines alpha^epoch blending and smoothing yprime=(1-eps)y+eps/V; Section5.3 default alpha=.99,eps=.1. Main code-synthesis tasks Lyra/Pisces train20epochs, Bugs2Fix2epochs.

Official README core implementation defaults alpha_base=.985,label_smoothing=.05; smooths non-target classes as eps/(V-1), target as1-eps; actual epoch supplied as cur_epoch+1. This is a paper/code mismatch.

substantive_differences: PLAN calls .99/.1 original defaults; queued sched20 actually uses .985/.1: official-code alpha with paper eps, not exactly either full default pair. .985 is sourced to official code and should not be described as invented.
20epoch exponent progression is continuously interpolated from1 to20 over a single1250step epoch; no actual20-pass training.
Local smoothing follows paper eps/V, not official README non-target eps/(V-1) convention.
Local ignores -100 prompt/pad positions and renormalizes valid answer tokens; official README ignores pad via mask and means over flattened input positions, so normalization may differ.
Local probability clamp is on mixed probability at1e-30; official README clamps softmax probabilities at1e-7 before mixing.
Second arm .5/.1 with epochs1 is a deliberately strong constant blending adaptation.
